# Let me look at the full context by reading in 5000 char chunks
# and searching for anything that looks like an agent turn
chunks = []
for offset in range(0, 41675, 5000):
    chunk = await CONTEXT.read(offset, 5000)
    chunks.append(chunk)

full = "".join(chunks)

# Find all tool call patterns
import re

# Find all [tool N] and [result N] sections
tool_starts = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'\[tool \d+\]', full)]
print(f"Found {len(tool_starts)} tool calls")
for ts in tool_starts[:5]:
    print(f"  at {ts}: {full[ts:ts+200]}")

# Find any [turn N] sections  
turn_starts = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'\[turn \d+\]', full)]
print(f"\nFound {len(turn_starts)} turns")
for ts in turn_starts[:5]:
    print(f"  at {ts}: {full[ts:ts+300]}")

# Find where the final message is
final_msg = full.find("[final message]")
print(f"\n[final message] at {final_msg}")
if final_msg >= 0:
    print(full[final_msg:final_msg+500])
